column3: Hand-calculated two-request schedule reports one useful-window success and one late job
Sorting and tie-breaks make the result independent of request/robot/leg row order
Geodesic-only evidence is never treated as a dispatchable travel duration
Missing route evidence leaves the request unknown and unassigned
Unvalidated or unsupported no-route claims fail closed
A structurally declared but unvalidated route cannot support an assignment
Unknown service duration remains an explicit unknown disposition
Known resource window prevents a schedule without wrapping or dropping the request
Unsupported task capability has its own disposition
Modeled and observed trip durations are reported in separate totals
Duplicate robot/from/to legs are an ambiguous route join
Route records from another season cannot be silently reused
Checked arithmetic rejects impossible time overflow
